title: Finitely presented stage model for a directed preorder
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $F:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a diagram with colimit $A$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every finitely presented $A$-module $X$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], there exist $i\in I$ and a finitely presented $F(i)$-module $M$ with $M\otimes_{F(i)}A\cong X$ along the canonical colimit map.

proof.text: Take the thin skeleton T of the preorder I. ThinSkeleton.equivalence identifies T with I, and transports filteredness. T is a nonempty directed partial order. Precompose F with the representative functor E:T→I. Functor.Final.colimitIso supplies q:colimit(E⋙F)≅colimit F, satisfying cocone compatibility.
Extend X along q.inv. Finite presentation is preserved by scalar extension. Apply the object clause of [lem-pc-fp-module-map-descent-affine] to this module and E⋙F, obtaining t, M and eM.

Cocone compatibility identifies q.hom composed with the stage map with the original colimit map at E(t). Apply extendScalarsComp to compare these scalar extensions. Apply the extended eM and cancel extension along q.inv followed by q.hom, using q.inv_hom_id and extendScalarsId. Their composite gives the required model at E(t).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finitePresentation_model_of_preorder_colimit
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) [HasColimit F]
    (X : ModuleCat.{u} (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}))
    (hX : Module.FinitePresentation (colimit F : CommRingCat.{u}) X) :
    ∃ (i : I) (M : ModuleCat.{u} (F.obj i)),
      Module.FinitePresentation (F.obj i) M ∧
      Nonempty ((extendScalars (colimit.ι F i).hom).obj M ≅ X)
